subject: Paraprofessional and Kids' Corner Contract Ratification
overview: The School Committee ratified labor contracts for paraprofessionals and kids' corner staff following an executive session. The meeting also featured updates on district activities and a report on vocational programming and state grant awards.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to discuss collective bargaining negotiations and pending litigation.

items.title: Labor Contract Ratification
items.summary: The committee unanimously ratified contracts for paraprofessionals and kids' corner staff to address pay equity.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the September 19 meeting along with bills and payroll.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent provided updates on student achievements, upcoming community festivals, holiday observations, and Italian American Heritage Month.

items.title: Vocational Programming Update
items.summary: Administrators reported on Chapter 74 programming, facility renovations, and the recent acquisition of Skills Capital and Mass Life Sciences grants for shop equipment.
